chapters.label: Penalty, live
chapters.text: London, December 2024. Chelsea lead Tottenham late on. Penalty! Cole Palmer steps up. He has never missed one in the Premier League. A slow run... he chips it down the middle! Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. Palmer sees the keeper getting ready to dive. So he stays calm, and dinks it softly, straight down the middle.

chapters.label: Behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal: the keeper has gone, and the ball floats in. Twelve penalties, twelve goals. Ice cold!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Take a deep breath. Look calm, then pick your spot, and trust it.
